fusions.name: Spun Web
fusions.desc: Looses 4 fine strands in a fan, each dealing 8 damage. Each hit has a 30% chance of [Pinned] for 3 seconds. Your afflictions on a target spread to every enemy within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Tangled Hop
fusions.desc: Flicks a fine stinger that deals 3 damage, then runs on to 3 more enemies within 3 tiles, each hit dealing 50% of the original damage. Each hit has a 25% chance of [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Fine-Toothed
fusions.desc: Increases your physical damage by 25% for 15 seconds. A tangle of strands fights beside you for 12 seconds, striking for 2 every 1 second.

fusions.name: Fine Print
fusions.desc: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on that enemy, up to 8. Your next critical hit on it spends them all: a blow strikes that enemy for 17% of your weapon damage per stack (136% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
